name: Operand nudge
notes: Live: every ten seconds, two operands of arithmetic, compare and load instructions the game runs move by a little. LDA #$05 becomes LDA #$06, CMP #$40 becomes CMP #$3F: almost-right speeds, timers and limits, and the code never goes out of step. Needs a code map: play the game a while first. Widen the range for bigger games.
